page.layout: One printed page, two columns of index entries under the running head "INDEX". Left column (mnes refertur to Omittens) and right column (F, P entries to Principale). No text in the margins, no page number, no catchword, no signature.

main_text.l: Matrimonium non licitum, sed honestum esse debet 1.197

Nullius quod esse potest obliga-ri nequit 1.182
Obligari nequit, quod nullius esse potest 1.182

Pars maior quod statuit, refertur ad omnes 1.160.§.1
Plus transferre quis nequit, quia ipse habet 1.54
Poenae nomine exactum soluenti non redditur 1.46

Poenalis actio semel accepta, trāfit in heredem 1.164

page.notes: Top line "mnes refertur" is a fragment continued from the previous page. The large "P" of "PActio" is a joined initial as printed. "accepta,trāfit": the abbreviation over "trā" is hard to read, the word may be "transfit" and is left as printed. "1.21" for the entry "Plus cui licet" is read from a small "2r" and is doubtful. "1.11" for "Nostrum, fine facto" is doubtful. The hyphen in "obliga-ri", "per-sona", "pa-reatur" and "sol-uit" is printed at the line end. The entry "in Obscuro" has its "in" printed in italic-looking type; kept as roman.
